NOTE: Earnings above are from continuing operations.
Q4 1996 earnings including discontinued operations were a net loss of $497 million, or $1.98/shr, versus a net profit of $40 million, or $0.16/shr, in Q4 1995.
Year 1996 earnings including discontinued operations were a net profit of $18 million, or $0.07/shr, versus a net profit of $224 million, or $0.91/shr in year 1995.

In a statement, Unocal said preliminary Q4 1996 consolidated earnings, excluding special items, were $150 million, or $0.60/shr. This compares with $92 million or $0.34/shr on the same basis for 1995. Preliminary full-year 1996 earnings, excluding special items, were $628 million, or $2.45 per common share, up 111 percent from $297 million, or $1.06 per common share, in 1995.
